continuation.text:
The Friday rule was already in `src/solution.py`, so I left it as it was. A start at 15:00 is allowed, and any later start on a Friday is excluded. I didn't run any checks or tests on the edited file.

I removed two restrictions that the current requirements don't ask for:
- **Lunch block:** starts between 12:00 and 13:00 are no longer excluded.
- **Post-event buffer:** the 15-minute gap after each event is gone, so a meeting can start right when an event ends.

I also made two small related edits. The Friday check now only runs when `day` is a string. I replaced the corrupted characters in the docstring and updated its constraint list to match.

The function name and signature are the same. Working hours (09:00–17:00), 15-minute start times, clipping of events to working hours and the date-to-weekday conversion are unchanged.

If you want the lunch block or the buffer back, they're easy to restore.
